remarks:
Excellent recreational property located in Frewsburg NY, Chautauqua County.

The 84 acres are mostly wooded with Conewango Creek running through it in various parts. Majority of the property is wetlands and hard to access. There are some woods off the road that is accessible but then you need to cross the creek to get towards the back of the property. Excellent property for hunting whitetail deer and waterfowl.  Annual taxes are $500.59. There is 1,000 feet of road frontage. Included is a sliver of land located on the opposite side of the road. All rights convey.

This property is located approximately 9 minutes to Jamestown NY, 12 minutes to Russell PA, 24 minutes to Bemus Point NY, 40 minutes to Westfield NY, 1 hour to Erie PA and 1 hour 20 minutes to Buffalo NY.
